import torch as t
import einops

def solve(ny, nz, yl, zl):
    y = t.linspace(-yl, yl, ny)
    z = t.linspace(-zl, zl, nz)
    yy = einops.repeat(y, 'y -> (y z)', z=nz)
    zz = einops.repeat(z, 'z -> (y z)', y=ny)
    return einops.rearrange([yy, zz], 'two n -> n two')

import einops
